blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Sandiganbayan Third Division on Tuesday called the attention of two government agencies and lawmakers regarding the equipment and staff needed by New Quezon City Jail in Barangay Payatas following the transfer of former Speaker Martin Romualdez. In a statement, the court said copies of its Sept. 14 order directing the transfer of Romualdez to the New Quezon City Jail has been sent to the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP), Department of Budget and Management (DBM), Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG), House of Representatives and Senate. “The furnishing of the Order brings the identified needs […]...
